include_heuristic.description: Also follow syntax-only (heuristic) edges. Default false.

max_depth.description: Hops from the changed files (default 2; 0 = unbounded).

max_symbols.description: Symbols listed, shallowest first (default 500; 0 = uncapped); total_symbols keeps the full count.

budget.description: Byte budget for the rendered list (default 4000)

since.description: RFC3339 timestamp; only pointers established at/after it (default: all recorded history)

depth.description: Reverse-graph depth to walk (default 1 = direct callers only). Values above 1 add transitive_callers (depth 2..N) and extend by_depth; 0 = unbounded.

include_heuristic.description: Add syntax-only (heuristic) callers, which come from bare-name matching. Default false.

with_signatures.description: SB-47: include each caller's full signature ("sig") on the wire row. Default false — the compact {loc, c} shape omits it.

name.description: Symbol name (bare or fully-qualified; exact spelling not required). Alias: "symbol" (additive — same field, either name works; both may be given only if they agree).

symbol.description: Alias for "name" (P1-1: the hot-tool quartet's primary argument is named differently per tool; this lets a caller reuse the same field name across all four).

path.description: Absolute corpus root — required only when first onboarding a new service

remap.description: Authorize re-pointing an EXISTING service's recorded root at a different path (O82). Without it, a differing path is refused — a hook must never re-point a service.

budget.description: Maximum hops (default 12, max 40) — always a floor under a bounded, terminating answer, never rejected for being too high

concern.description: A free-text description of the area or problem — significant terms are searched

error.description: An error message, verbatim — quoted literals and any embedded file:line frames are parsed out as seeds

failing_test.description: A failing test's name (subtests like TestFoo/bar are split at the first "/" for the symbol lookup)

stack_trace.description: A stack trace or traceback, verbatim — file:line frames and function names are parsed out as seeds

query.description: Substring terms over claim/anchor keys; empty = all

action.description: Feedback verb (D2): when set, this call records a claim_events verdict instead of looking up rules. Requires claim_id and note.

author.description: Verdict author (optional; empty for an automated caller)

claim_id.description: Claim ID being refuted/corroborated (required when action is set)

file.description: Repo-relative file path being edited. Omit (with no action) for root-scope obligations — "what governs this repository" — instead of an error.

include_snippets.description: Inline each rule's cited lines as snippet, capped at 240 bytes (default true). Set false for the smallest possible payload.

layer.description: Which claims to serve (VB-9): "rules" (default) is human-authored governing rules only; "claims" is plan-row bindings bound strictly by their own {symbol, package} contract; "all" is the pre-VB-9 union of both.

note.description: Verdict rationale (required when action is set)

path.description: Alias for `file` (wave P3 / O82): a caller that passed `path` instead of `file` used to silently fall back to root-scope rules only. `file` wins when both are given.

concern.description: Concern ID to scope the query
Concern ID to scope the query (e.g. "authentication"). Alias: "symbol" (additive — same field, either name works; both may be given only if they agree).

keywords.description: Optional keyword hints for relevance scoring

symbol.description: Alias for "concern" (P1-1: the hot-tool quartet's primary argument is named differently per tool; this lets a caller reuse the same field name across all four).

top.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20)

end_line.description: 1-based end line, inclusive (default: start_line + 199, or EOF). An explicit range wider than the cap is refused, not narrowed.

file.description: Repo-relative file path (never absolute, never containing "..")

max_bytes.description: Per-call byte budget (default 8000, ceiling 16000). Raise it for one call instead of re-calling with a narrower range.

exact.description: SB-45: keep only occurrences the typed pass confirmed (edge_confidence: resolved) — identifier uses, never a comment or doc mention. Defaults to true when at least one queried service's last ingest reported typed edges (staleness_report's typed_edges); false restores every text occurrence. A service with no typed reference sites for this query falls back automatically and is named in degraded.

include_heuristic.description: Also list definitions whose name merely CONTAINS the query ("FooBar" for "Foo"), and (SB-45) add back the bare text occurrences exact mode drops. Default false.

query.description: String to search for: an identifier, a dotted path ("pkg.Sym" or "Type.Method"), or a regex (with regex: true). Alias: "symbol" (additive — same field, either name works; both may be given only if they agree).

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression

services.description: Service IDs to search (default: all known services)

symbol.description: Alias for "query" (P1-1: the hot-tool quartet's primary argument is named differently per tool; this lets a caller reuse the same field name across all four).

changed_files.description: Repo-relative changed file paths (e.g. from git diff --name-only)

concern.description: Optional concern token (currently descriptive only; carried for forward compatibility)

coverage_profile.description: Optional single-profile alias for coverage_profiles: a repo-relative path to one Go cover profile, labeled layer "unit" (no per-profile layer metadata exists to say otherwise). Ignored when coverage_profiles is also given.

coverage_profiles.description: Optional: one entry per test layer — {layer, path}, each path repo-relative under the service's corpus root (e.g. workspace/cov/unit.out). Enables the "coverage" dimension with real per-layer attribution; absent (and no coverage_profile) = checked:false, reason "no coverage profile supplied".

symbol_id.description: Alias for symbol — a fully-qualified SymbolKey

case.description: Case-sensitive match. Default true (grep/ripgrep's own default); false for case-insensitive.

context.description: Lines of context before and after each hit (default 0).

path.description: Optional glob (gitignore-style, e.g. "internal/mcp/**/*.go") narrowing which files are searched.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (Go regexp syntax — must compile; the same pattern text is handed to ripgrep when it runs the search).

root.description: Absolute filesystem directory to search directly (no index lookup, so sym/kind are omitted; flags/class still render). Give exactly one of service or root.

service.description: Service / repo identifier — searches its indexed corpus root and enables sym/kind receipts. Give exactly one of service or root.

snippet.description: Include the inline definition source snippet (default true). Set false to omit it.

concern.description: Optional concern to scope contradiction detection

plan_markdown.description: Markdown checklist alternative to tasks: each '- [ ] title [SPEC-ID] {symbol: Foo, package: dir/of/foo, reachable_from: Bar, min_tier: verified}' line becomes a task. Annotations must sit on the checkbox line itself.

plan_path.description: Repo-relative path plan_markdown was read from. Optional; when given and the service's recorded corpus root is a real git checkout, a claimed row's skip_test is checked against git history — a skip added in the same edit/commit that claims the row done is refused as self-skipped (O56), never graded by the agent's own hand.

package.description: Optional repo-relative directory the symbol's file must live under (disambiguates a bare name that exists in several packages)

skip.description: Justification for skip_test — mirrors the Markdown checklist's `skip:` annotation key. A bare skip_test with no reason is refused as skip-without-reason (O56).

skip_test.description: Don't require a test to reach symbol

spec_ids.description: Spec IDs that must be covered

symbol.description: Symbol that must exist in the index
